decisions.reason: The KLR datum imports def-symmetrizable-cartan-datum-for-a-quantum-group, whose Definition explicitly makes I finite nonempty. Thus there are finitely many sequences and weights of height n; the fixed-weight finite dot-degree argument in step 8.1 gives finite homogeneous components of their finite sum R_n(Q). The infinite-I counterexample is outside the actual hypotheses. The polynomial action, component grading, braid correction and triangular field-automorphism independence argument were examined; no item change is warranted.

Relation (6) gives x_a tau_a e(nu)=tau_a x_{a+1} e(nu)+e(nu) and x_{a+1} tau_a e(nu)=tau_a x_a e(nu)-e(nu) on equal colours. Neither the whole-expression plus/minus rule in old step 1.1 nor its positive choice gives the first identity. Replaced it with both exact rules and the decreasing dot/crossing inversion argument. Reduced-word corrections, localized leading permutations, Hilbert series and local finiteness remain valid; Statement unchanged.

F3 incorrectly used e(nu) as the right idempotent of e(nu)R_3e(nu-prime), and omitted w nu-prime=nu. Corrected both clauses. The actual braid calculation is in the diagonal (i,j,i) block and follows directly from relation (7), so this misstatement did not invalidate the computed example: classify nonfatal. Also corrected second difference to first divided difference and justified nonvanishing by distinct PBW dot monomials, including characteristic two. Quadratic and cubic signs and total degree 2 were checked; no Statement/Definition section changes.

Old step 1.1 identified the full m-variable polynomial ring with the first rank-m root extension; for m=3 its actual rank is 6. Replaced this by the full successive monic-root tower A_0 through A_m, proved each extension rank m-r+1 and the final polynomial-ring isomorphism by coefficient comparison and inverse substitution. Its Artin basis has rank m!, and PBW then gives central rank (height(beta)!)^2. The finite endomorphism splitting, central-augmentation annihilation, nilpotent degree-zero idempotent lifting and projective-cover/orbit-basis arguments remain sound. Statement unchanged.

The Krull-Schmidt Statement does not assert central freeness, as the rejection says, but its explicit proof step 1.1 establishes that prerequisite. After repairing that supplier tower, made the Cartan well-definedness citation point exactly to the proved monic-root/PBW calculation rather than presenting freeness as a stated interface clause. Also supplied the split-tensor argument exhibiting V=P^psi tensor_R Q as a finite graded projective C_beta-module. Homogeneous augmentation-basis lifting, projective splitting and bounded-below graded Nakayama make V shifted-free and give the stated Laurent-polynomial times (beta)_q range. The balance flip, evaluation and shift formulas are valid. This is a nonfatal imprecise attribution with an actual proved supplier, not an unsatisfied mathematical prerequisite. Definition unchanged.

The old Statement said right-string and F4 advertised LEFT/right recursion, but neither quantum supplier promises unsigned right recursion. The actual proof step 6.1 already uses LEFT recursion throughout. Replaced the mismatched Statement wording by LEFT and made F4 quote the exact left transition of thm-the-highest-weight-crystal-triple-is-balanced(v). The positive-basis conclusion, first-block expansion and ideal equality are preserved. Checked word-character separation, parity normalization, evaluation duality, projective adjunction multiplicities and exact left-quotient sign induction. This unsupported extra attribution is nonfatal to the existing left proof. Kashiwara91 pp. 513-515 corroborate the left divided-power quotient construction and its coefficient +1; they do not supply the advertised unsigned right inference.
